trace.answer:
"Doubling Down: Mark Roberge, Co-Founder and Managing Director at Stage 2 Capital"
Mark Roberge is co-founder and managing director at Stage 2 Capital where he focuses on early-stage investments across software, fintech, and consumer technologies with a focus on SaaS companies. Prior to joining venture capital, Mark had an accomplished career building and scaling businesses in enterprise software. He was the VP of Sales for HubSpot during their hypergrowth phase when they went public. Later, he became a professor of entrepreneurship and marketing at Harvard Business School, teaching entrepreneurial strategy and sales leadership. As part of his research, he published several books including “The Sales Acceleration Formula” which explores how to build high-performing revenue teams.
______
My Top 10 Learnings:
1. Focus your portfolio company investment team
– Many VC firms have multiple partners investing together, but if you can get them all aligned, even better. If you don’t need that many brains, then just one will do. The key is alignment and agreement between the investors so you can leverage each others’ strengths.
2. Look for “accidental entrepreneurs”
– These are people who stumble upon great business ideas through their regular work. They often lack the confidence to pursue these opportunities because they’re comfortable in their current roles. It’s up to VCs like me to spot this talent and encourage them to take the leap.
